disease_state.evidence: Here, we report the development of a de novo immune complex-mediated glomerulonephritis (GN) in a kidney transplant recipient with chronic hepatitis E.

material_type.evidence:
Laser capture microscopy (LCM)
To perform mass spectrometry analysis of glomerular extracts from Patient 1, glomeruli stained for HEV ORF2 protein (1E6 antibody) were dissected using the ArcturusXT™ LCM System (Thermo Scientific).
Plasma sample was subjected to HEV genotyping following amplification of HEV ORF2 (592 bp) sequence, as described.
